segments.name: Janus North America
segments.description: Manufactures and supplies commercial and self-storage doors, walls, hallway systems and building components for self-storage owners and builders, and provides installation services.
segments.evidence: Janus North America produces and provides various fabricated components such as commercial and self-storage doors, walls, hallway systems and building components used primarily by owners or builders of self-storage facilities and also offers installation services along with the products.

segments.name: Janus International
segments.description: Produces and provides similar doors, walls, hallway systems and building components, plus installation services, for customers largely in Europe, the U.K., and Australia.
segments.evidence: The Janus International segment produces and provides similar products and services as Janus North America but largely in Europe, the U.K., and Australia.

revenueModel.text: Self-storage owners and builders, commercial and trucking customers pay for doors, hallway systems, steel structures, automation technology, and installation and renovation services.
revenueModel.evidence: Product revenues represent the revenue from the sale of products, including steel roll-up and swing doors, rolling steel doors, steel structures, as well as hallway systems and facility and door automation technologies for commercial and self-storage customers.
